reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on a speculative dual mechanism (M–N bond strengthening and Pt-rich shell formation) from a single nitriding/etching treatment on a complex multi-principal-element alloy, without addressing how this treatment would selectively affect the many different metals present or how it avoids poisoning active sites, making it scientifically questionable.
reasons.testability: The proposed falsification test is clear and well-defined, with specific measurements and a quantitative criterion (15–20% durability improvement), though the complexity of the multi-element system makes isolating the effect of the treatment challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a relevant problem but proposes a poorly justified and overly complex intervention for a multi-element alloy, offering limited practical guidance for a researcher seeking a single, effective modification.
